workarounds.symptom: hindsight-api exits at start-up with UnicodeEncodeError when stdout is redirected on Windows
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(api): a redirected stdout on Windows no longer stops the server at start-up. Target files: hindsight-api-slim/hindsight_api/admin/cli.py, hindsight-api-slim/hindsight_api/main.py, hindsight-api-slim/hindsight_api/utils.py. **Problem.** Before Python 3.15, a redirected stdout on Windows (`hindsight-api > hindsight.log`) uses the ANSI code page (cp1252, cp949). It cannot encode the banner logo's block characters, so the server exited with `UnicodeEncodeError` before it served anything. (Ref: https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/pull/6508)

workarounds.symptom: Retain failures (execution errors, client cancellation, worker timeouts) leak unreferenced attachments in storage
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(attachments): a daily sweep deletes the attachments of retains that failed (#6350). The API stores a retain's images and files **before** the retain runs (the async path can't carry the bytes in its operation row). If the retain then fails — LLM error, client disconnect, a worker giving up — n... (Ref: https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/pull/6474)

workarounds.symptom: coding-agents: recall/reflect query is built from the raw prompt, including injected <system-reminder> blocks, so fallback recall can miss the user's words
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(coding-agents): strip host-injected tags from the prompt before recall/reflect. Target files: hindsight-integrations/coding-agents/src/core/hook.test.ts, hindsight-integrations/coding-agents/src/core/hook.ts, hindsight-integrations/coding-agents/src/core/runtime.test.ts. Some hosts (e.g. the Claude desktop app) put a `<system-reminder>` block before the user's words in the prompt. The prompt hook used it as-is, so the recall query (cut to ~1,000 chars from the start) and the reflect goal were mostly host boilerplate. (Ref: https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/pull/6491)
